default.title: Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
default.description: Discover Pensiunea Perla Brazilor, a welcoming guesthouse nestled among the fir trees of northern Romania's mountains. Enjoy authentic hospitality, traditional food, and complete tranquility—ideal for family vacations or romantic getaways.

home.title: Home - Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
home.description: Welcome to Pensiunea Perla Brazilor – your haven of peace in the heart of nature. Discover our charming guesthouse, surrounded by fir forests, with comfortable rooms, traditional food, and unforgettable moments in any season.

book_now.title: Book Now - Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
book_now.description: Secure your stay at Pensiunea Perla Brazilor – a place where relaxation and nature meet. Book a room simply and quickly and enjoy comfort, hospitality, and authentic experiences in the heart of Bucovina.

offers.title: Our Offers - Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
offers.description: Discover our special offers at Pensiunea Perla Brazilor: Half Board Package, Christmas Package, and New Year's Eve celebration. Book your mountain vacation today.

new_years_offer.title: New Year 2026-2027 in Bucovina - Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
new_years_offer.description: Spend an unforgettable New Year in Bucovina at Pensiunea Perla Brazilor. All-inclusive package with 4 nights accommodation, festive meals, sleigh rides, live music and access to the spa. Book now for an authentic traditional New Year experience!

half_board_offer.title: Half Board Offer - Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
half_board_offer.description: Enjoy accommodation with half board at Pensiunea Perla Brazilor. The package includes breakfast and dinner buffet, traditional dishes, access to the spa and modern facilities. Authentic experience in Bucovina with 60% of the food from our own production.

christmas_offer.title: Christmas 2026 in Bucovina - Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
christmas_offer.description: Spend a traditional Christmas in Bucovina at Pensiunea Perla Brazilor. All-inclusive package with 4 nights accommodation, festive meals, carolers, sleigh rides, traditional pig slaughter and access to the spa. An authentic holiday experience!

spa.title: Spa & Wellness - Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
spa.description: Relax in our spa area with swimming pool, salt water tub, jacuzzi, salt mine and Finnish sauna. An oasis of peace and well-being in the heart of Bucovina, for complete rejuvenation.

our_rooms.title: Our Rooms - Pensiunea Perla Brazilor
our_rooms.description: Discover our comfortable rooms and apartments with mountain views. From double rooms to spacious apartments, all modernly equipped for a perfect stay in Bucovina.

AboutSection.title: Despre noi
AboutSection.description: Pensiunea Perla Brazilor este locul pe care familia noastră l-a construit cu drag, în 2003, în Frumosu — înconjurați de păduri de brad, pe Valea Moldoviței, la câțiva kilometri de Mănăstirea Moldovița.
AboutSection.feature_1_desc: We cook at home, with our own ingredients. Authentic Bukovina recipes, at every meal.
AboutSection.feature_2_desc: Mountain air, fir forests and that feeling that time stands still a little.
AboutSection.feature_3_desc: Pool, salt water hot tub, sauna and salt mine — everything you need to disconnect.

Rooms.title: Our Rooms

APB.title: Apartment With Balcony
APB.description: The apartment has two well-defined rooms, with the bathroom centrally located for easy access from both. The first room is equipped with a double bed. The second room offers both a double bed and a sofa bed. This structure ensures maximum comfort and flexibility for guests.

DBB.title: Double Room With Balcony
DBB.description: All double rooms with balcony offer enchanting views and are equipped with private bathrooms with shower, ensuring privacy and complete comfort. Each room has a double bed, creating a generous and comfortable space for relaxation and admiring the landscape.

DB.title: Double Room Without Balcony
DB.description: Our double rooms, without balcony, are comfortable and intimate and include private bathrooms with shower, guaranteeing privacy and convenience. Each of these rooms offers a generous double bed, creating an ideal space for rest and relaxation.

SB.title: Suite With Balcony
SB.description: Our exclusive suite includes two interconnected rooms with a balcony, creating a spacious and private space with access to the outdoors. Each of these welcoming rooms is equipped with a comfortable double bed, guaranteeing a relaxing and intimate stay for our guests.

TPB.title: Triple Room With Balcony
TPB.description: All triple rooms with balcony are equipped with a comfortable double bed and a sofa bed, offering generous additional space for relaxation and additional accommodation. Perfect for families or larger groups, these rooms with balcony add extra comfort and a pleasant perspective for a wonderful stay.

TP.title: Triple Room Without Balcony
TP.description: Our triple rooms, without balcony, are equipped with a comfortable double bed and an ingenious single bed, which integrates into the closet to maximize space. This smart layout offers our guests flexibility and increased comfort during their stay.

spa.subtitle: Your oasis of relaxation!
spa.desc: The offer includes access to the spa. Enjoy well-being in the salt water tub, swimming pool, salt mine, sauna, or jacuzzi.

dec23.title: December 23
dec23.desc: Enjoy a warm welcome, with traditions like in Bucovina.

dec24.title: December 24
dec24.desc: At 10 AM, start with a horse-drawn sleigh ride, then enjoy an outdoor meal with traditional pig slaughter, barbecue and stewed steak, along with mulled wine, boiled brandy and delicious Poale-n Brâu. In the evening, at dinner, Carolers and Santa Claus will bring the magic of the holidays.

dec25.title: December 25
dec25.desc: In a festive atmosphere, enjoy traditional dishes, selected drinks and good cheer with your loved ones, from 2:30 PM, to the rhythms of a live orchestra.

dec26.title: December 26
dec26.desc: You are free to spend the day as you wish – either on the ski slope in Câmpulung Moldovenesc, or exploring the local beauties, such as the Moldovița and Voroneț monasteries, the pottery from Marginea (Black Ceramics) or a ride with the Huțulca Mocanița from Moldovița.

dec29.title: December 29
dec29.desc: We start the vacation with a warm welcome in Bucovina style and a welcome dinner, so you can get acquainted with the first tastes of our local cuisine.

dec30.title: December 30
dec30.desc: At 10 AM, we start with a horse-drawn cart ride through the winter landscape of Bucovina. After the road, we stop for an outdoor meal with traditional food: pig slaughter, barbecues, stewed steak, mulled wine, boiled brandy and Poale-n Brâu - perfect for a real winter day.

dec31.title: December 31
dec31.desc: The day is free for walks and visits around the area, until 9:00 PM, when the New Year's Eve party begins. A rich menu awaits you with appetizers, hot dishes of turkey, pork and veal, fish and much more – all with live music and dancing until morning.

jan1.title: January 1
jan1.desc: The first day of the year is for relaxation, as you wish. You can go skiing in Câmpulung Moldovenesc, visit the monasteries in the area (Moldovița, Voroneț, Humor, Sucevița), the black ceramics workshops in Marginea or take a ride with the Mocănița through the Moldovița valley.

reviews.text: We were warmly welcomed by the guesthouse owner, a woman worth a 10. We've had previous stays in 4-star hotels and never felt like we do here. It's impeccable!
reviews.author: Familia Darius

reviews.text: We spent Easter holidays in a fascinating Bucovina region, together with a welcoming host and staff rated 10 plus! The food is irresistible!
reviews.author: Georgică R.

reviews.text: I recommend to all who want a relaxing vacation where mountain tranquility harmoniously blends with resort-like conditions. Mrs. Ioana and all staff are welcoming people.
reviews.author: Nicoleta C.

reviews.text: It was like a dream - a host worth 10+, excellent accommodation, a menu I have no words for. Our whole group felt great!
reviews.author: Familia Marian G.

reviews.text: Whenever I feel an acute need for relaxation, I come here, to Perla Brazilor. The hosts are extraordinary people!
reviews.author: Mitrea
